+import os
+
+import pytest
+
+import click
+
+
+def test_repeated_scalar_default_map_string():
+    option = click.Option(["--number"], type=int, multiple=True)
+    command = click.Command("tool", params=[option])
+    ctx = command.make_context("tool", [], default_map={"number": "1 2 3"})
+    assert ctx.params["number"] == (1, 2, 3)
+    assert ctx.get_parameter_source("number") is click.ParameterSource.DEFAULT_MAP
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("text", ["1 2 3 4", "1 2 3 4 5"])
+def test_repeated_fixed_arity_default_map_string(text):
+    option = click.Option(["--pair"], type=int, nargs=2, multiple=True)
+    command = click.Command("tool", params=[option])
+    ctx = command.make_context("tool", [], default_map={"pair": text})
+    assert ctx.params["pair"] == ((1, 2), (3, 4))
+    assert ctx.get_parameter_source("pair") is click.ParameterSource.DEFAULT_MAP
+
+
+def test_default_map_string_uses_type_delimiter():
+    option = click.Option(["--path"], type=click.Path(), multiple=True)
+    command = click.Command("tool", params=[option])
+    text = os.pathsep.join(["alpha", "beta"])
+    ctx = command.make_context("tool", [], default_map={"path": text})
+    assert ctx.params["path"] == ("alpha", "beta")
+
+
+def test_inherited_callable_default_map_string_is_acquired_once():
+    calls = []
+
+    def default():
+        calls.append(True)
+        return "1 2 3 4"
+
+    option = click.Option(["--pair"], type=int, nargs=2, multiple=True)
+    child = click.Command("child", params=[option])
+    parent = click.Context(
+        click.Group("root"), default_map={"child": {"pair": default}}
+    )
+    ctx = child.make_context("child", [], parent=parent)
+    assert calls == [True]
+    assert ctx.params["pair"] == ((1, 2), (3, 4))
+    assert ctx.get_parameter_source("pair") is click.ParameterSource.DEFAULT_MAP
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("mapped, expected", [(["1", "2"], (1, 2)), (None, ())])
+def test_explicit_sequence_and_none_default_map_values(mapped, expected):
+    option = click.Option(["--number"], type=int, multiple=True, default=[9])
+    command = click.Command("tool", params=[option])
+    ctx = command.make_context("tool", [], default_map={"number": mapped})
+    assert ctx.params["number"] == expected
+    assert ctx.get_parameter_source("number") is click.ParameterSource.DEFAULT_MAP
+
+
+def test_explicit_nested_sequence_default_map_value():
+    option = click.Option(["--pair"], type=int, nargs=2, multiple=True)
+    command = click.Command("tool", params=[option])
+    ctx = command.make_context(
+        "tool", [], default_map={"pair": [["1", "2"], ["3", "4"]]}
+    )
+    assert ctx.params["pair"] == ((1, 2), (3, 4))
+
+
+def test_cli_and_environment_keep_precedence(monkeypatch):
+    option = click.Option(
+        ["--number"], type=int, multiple=True, envvar="CLICK_MAP_NUMBERS"
+    )
+    command = click.Command("tool", params=[option])
+    monkeypatch.setenv("CLICK_MAP_NUMBERS", "7 8")
+    ctx = command.make_context("tool", [], default_map={"number": "1 2"})
+    assert ctx.params["number"] == (7, 8)
+    assert ctx.get_parameter_source("number") is click.ParameterSource.ENVIRONMENT
+    ctx = command.make_context(
+        "tool", ["--number", "6"], default_map={"number": "1 2"}
+    )
+    assert ctx.params["number"] == (6,)
+    assert ctx.get_parameter_source("number") is click.ParameterSource.COMMANDLINE
